question.text:

  1. $\text{SLR(1)}$
  2. $\text{LR (0)}$
  3. $\text{LL (0)}$
  4. $\text{None of these}$

Let $G$ be a grammar with the following productions:

  • $E \rightarrow E+T \mid T$
  • $T \rightarrow T*F \mid F$
  • $T \rightarrow (E) \mid T-F$
  • $F \rightarrow id$


If $LR(1)$ parser is used to construct the DFA using the above productions, how many look-aheads are present for the item $T \to .T * F$ in the initial state?

Consider the following grammar:

  • $E \rightarrow T{E}’$
  • ${E}’ \rightarrow +T{E}’ \mid \epsilon$
  • $T \rightarrow F{T}’$
  • ${T}’ \rightarrow *F{T}’\mid \epsilon$
  • $F \rightarrow (E) \mid id$


Which of the following is correct regarding the entry in the predictive parsing table (LL(1) parsing table) $M$ for above grammar?
 

  1. $M\left[T, (\right] = T \to FT',\quad M[T',+] = T' \to \epsilon$
  2. $M[E', )] = E' \to \epsilon,\quad M[E',*] \to E' \to \epsilon$
  3. $M[E, (] = E \to TE',\quad M[E,*] \to E \to \epsilon$
  4. $M[T, id] = T \to FT',\quad M[T,)] = T \to FT'$
